market_pulse.note: About $60,831 Sunday afternoon (17:13 UTC), up 1.08% over 24 hours but down 5.45% over seven days and 25.01% over 30 days; earlier Sunday it traded as high as about $61,094 (Coin-Turk; ad-hoc-news).
About $1,724, up 2.37% on the day, with a market value of about $210.7 billion; it is down about 5.8% from a week ago (MetaMask).
About $2.01 trillion to $2.09 trillion depending on the data provider, down from more than $4 trillion at last year's peak (KuCoin; TV-Hub).
Between about 57.9% and 60% depending on the provider; Ethereum's share is about 9.8% (TV-Hub; KuCoin).

themes.title: Rebound above $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000 on Sunday after falling to about $55,081 on Saturday, its November low; it remains roughly half its October 2025 record of about $126,210 (Coin-Turk; ad-hoc-news).

themes.title: Seventh straight weekly loss
themes.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a seventh consecutive weekly decline, the longest losing streak since 2022 (ad-hoc-news).

themes.title: Extreme fear persists
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 11, 'extreme fear', on Sunday (Coin-Turk; KuCoin).

themes.title: Liquidations and ETF outflows
themes.summary: About $2.4 billion of crypto futures were liquidated on Nov. 20, more than $1 billion of it in Bitcoin, and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.1 billion of net outflows in the prior week, per CoinDesk figures cited by Coin-Turk (Coin-Turk).

themes.title: Prediction markets lean lower
themes.summary: Polymarket traders put 56% odds on Bitcoin trading at $55,000 before year-end and 30% on $50,000; Kalshi's median year-end forecast is about $61,062. Puts made up about 58% of options volume (KuCoin/Odaily).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin up about 1% and Ether up about 2.4% over 24 hours Sunday, but both are lower on the week (Coin-Turk; MetaMask).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: XRP was near $0.93 and Solana near $70 over the weekend, little changed (Cryptonews; crypto.news).

categories.name: Small caps and trending tokens
categories.note: Small tokens led gains: Venice Token (VVV) topped CoinCodex's daily list, and GEODNET (GEOD) was among CoinMarketCap's trending coins earlier Sunday (CoinCodex; CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Strategy closed Friday at $77.80, down 9.7%, and Coinbase fell 6.3% to $101.97; both trade again Monday (Ted Pillows).

watch_list.why: Saturday's low near $55,081 and the year-end price levels priced in prediction markets frame the range traders are watching into the weekly close (Coin-Turk; KuCoin/Odaily).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), a large Bitcoin holder, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
October PCE inflation is due Wednesday, Nov. 25, ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision; analysts tie crypto's recovery to steadier tech stocks and rates (JournalArta; Coin-Turk).
